as_told.title: CIA document on Robert Monroe's Hemi-Sync technique

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, talking with a researcher of psychic matters, Jeffrey Mishlove, mentions a paper from the mid-1980s about Hemi-Sync, a sound-based technique linked to Robert Monroe and the Monroe Institute in Virginia. Michels says a lot of people now cite this paper, which he raises as part of a wider talk about psychics, altered states and the afterlife.
